answer: Decentralized trust blooms like an orchard anchored to mutual verification, where identity is not a solitary tree but an interconnected grove of cryptographically staked attestations. When malicious actors attempt to flood this network like an unruly ocean, consensus enforces quadratic staking penalties with superlinear slashing. Multiplying false identities imposes superlinear attacker cost, suffocating fraudulent branches before they can poison collective consensus.
